tests.status: reviewed; adapter and strict visual evidence
tests.notes: Better Auth errors preserve the original public messages. Login/signup success events are restored and deferred until tenant telemetry consent resolves; opt-out discards them without rotating the PostHog session. Challenge-required submission resumes once after a token arrives. Invitation states have strict visual evidence and session reads honor both retry headers.
